faq.menu:
📖 Frequently asked questions

Choose a topic:

mission.title: 1️⃣ What is the project's mission?
mission.body:
Palph was built so studying stops feeling like a chore and starts feeling like something you want to do.

We combine gamification (coins, streaks, a pet, achievements, tips) with evidence-based learning techniques (spaced repetition, SM-2, active recall, Pomodoro). You get a system that:
• replaces dull cramming with small wins,
• gives instant feedback — the main antidote to procrastination,
• keeps motivation up through an emotional bond with your pet,
• turns studying into a habit that doesn't rely on willpower every single day.

The main goal: you learn more effectively and actually enjoy it.

efficiency.title: 2️⃣ Why is studying with the bot more effective than alone?
efficiency.body: The bot combines several proven techniques in one loop: Pomodoro (25-minute sessions = less burnout), instant motivation (coins, achievements, pet emotions), productivity tips with small rewards, regular reminders, and quizzes with spaced repetition. You get structure and feedback that are easy to lose when studying solo.

pet.title: 3️⃣ Why is there a pet and how does it help you study?
pet.body:
Your pet is a study companion, not just profile decoration. It stays with you through every session: reflects your activity, responds when you come back to study, and gently shows when you've dropped out of rhythm — without lecturing or guilt.

That makes learning feel less like a lonely obligation. You have a partner that grows with you: level, XP, customization, and mood give you another reason to open the bot and do even a short session. Emotional feedback between study blocks helps you stay motivated — especially when willpower alone isn't enough.

Bonding with a virtual companion is well supported in games and learning apps: it's easier to keep going when someone is «with you», not just a to-do list.

spend_coins.title: 4️⃣ What can you spend coins on?
spend_coins.body: Right now coins reward studying and help you unlock achievements. Soon you'll be able to buy pet customization: colors (orange, blue, green…) and accessories (hat, glasses, scarf, crown). More coming — follow the channel 📢.

earn_coins.title: 5️⃣ How do you earn coins?
earn_coins.body:
• +1 coin per minute of study via the timer
• +15 bonus when your streak reaches 2+ days
• Bonus coins for achievements (see profile)
• +1 coin per correct MCQ answer
• +1 coin per flashcard reviewed
• Up to +3 coins per picture task (depends on attempt)
• +1 coin for the first tip of the day in «🎓 Productivity tips» (time management, memory, or bot guide)
• «💡 Curious» achievement bonus — 10 tips read (+30 🪙)
• Morning reminder may include a «tip of the day» (once per calendar day)

sm2.title: 6️⃣ What is SM-2 and why is it effective for flashcards?
sm2.body: SM-2 (SuperMemo-2) is an algorithm that «remembers» how hard each card is for you. Struggled to recall — the card comes back soon; easy — a week or more later. You don't waste time on what you already know and see more of what slips away. Used in Anki and based on Ebbinghaus forgetting curve research.

spaced_rep.title: 7️⃣ What is spaced repetition?
spaced_rep.body: The idea: material sticks better if you review it with growing gaps — e.g. 1, 3, 7, 16 days. Each successful review lengthens the interval; a mistake resets the counter. Ebbinghaus demonstrated this in 1885; decades of research confirm it. Reviewing over days and weeks beats cramming in one evening.

active_recall.title: 8️⃣ What is active recall and which modes use it?
active_recall.body:
Active recall means pulling information from memory without peeking. It works 2–3× better than re-reading. In the bot it's built into every study mode:
• Situational quizzes — type the definition from a scenario
• Flashcards — see the term, recall, then check
• Productivity tips — short time-management and memory techniques
• Multiple choice — pick the right answer out of four
• Picture tasks — solve and type the answer
Rule of thumb: «if you can explain it, you know it».

guarantee.title: 9️⃣ Do you guarantee results?
guarantee.body:
Strong results are very likely, but there's no 100% guarantee — and that's normal.

Every technique in the bot (spaced repetition, SM-2, active recall, Pomodoro, gamification) is backed by decades of research: from Ebbinghaus (1885) to modern meta-analyses. Users who study regularly through the bot do noticeably better than with passive re-reading.

But real outcomes depend on:
• you — how often you study and how honestly you rate flashcards
• content — quality and structure of the material
• circumstances — stress, sleep, and wellbeing strongly affect memory
• starting point — everyone has a different level and pace

In short: with regular practice you're very likely to improve. We don't promise «guaranteed genius in a month» — that wouldn't be honest.

why_free.title: 🔟 Why is it free?
why_free.body:
The bot is free because the project has two main goals: build a strong developer portfolio and help as many students as possible prepare for their exam session.

Monetization isn't a priority right now — what matters more is that the tool stays available to everyone getting ready for exams.

user_tasks.instruction:
📋 How to add your own tasks from a .txt file File format (UTF-8 encoding, .txt extension): Each task is one line: question || answer | other answer Use || between the prompt and answers. Multiple correct answers are separated by |. Examples: What is 2+2? || 4 | four Work sampling method? || photography | photo Hint (optional), after answers with ##: How many planets? || 8 ## There are 8 planets in the Solar System Comments — lines starting with # Empty lines are ignored. Limits: up to 50 tasks per subject, file up to 64 KB. Already have task text? Copy the prompt below into ChatGPT, Claude, or another AI, replace PASTE_YOUR_TEXT_HERE with your material, save the reply as .txt (UTF-8), and send the file here. 
Convert the study tasks below into the format for this Telegram bot.

Output rules (strict):
- One task = one line of text
- Line format: question || answer1 | answer2
- Exactly two || characters between question and answers
- Separate multiple correct answers with a single |
- Hint (if any in the source): after answers use ## hint text
- No numbering, bullets, headings, or blank lines
- No explanations — output only ready task lines

Example line:
What is 2+2? || 4 | four

Source task text:
---
PASTE_YOUR_TEXT_HERE
---
Send the finished .txt file in this chat. To cancel — /cancel
